payload.title: CHANGELOG.md tops out at 0.6.0 while the package version is 0.13.0
payload.description:
**Problem**
The changelog is out of date by several releases, so readers cannot see what changed since 0.6.0.

**Evidence**
- CHANGELOG.md top entry is `## 0.6.0`.
- pyproject.toml:7 `version = "0.13.0"`.

**Fix**
Backfill the missing release notes (0.7.0 to 0.13.0) from git history, and check that semantic-release (configured in pyproject.toml) is writing to this file on release.

**How to verify**
The first heading under `# Changelog` in CHANGELOG.md matches the version in pyproject.toml.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
